items.q: What is Full Truckload transport?
items.a: Full Truckload, or FTL, uses a dedicated vehicle for an accepted consignment instead of combining it with other customers’ freight.

items.q: What is Part Load Transport?
items.a: Part Load Transport, also called PTL, consolidates compatible consignments so a customer can move a smaller load without booking a complete vehicle.

items.a: Depending on cargo acceptance and route, PTL may include properly packaged drums, carboys, cartons, bags, pallets and other industrial packages.
